title: Classes at Ateneo de Zamboanga continue amid tighter security

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Classes were not suspended at the Ateneo de Zamboanga University (AdZU) Grade School Department on Monday, but campus administrators, with the help of the police, elevated internal security protocols following circulating online threats of an alleged attack at the campus. Lt. Col. Shellamie Chang, spokesperson for Police Regional Office 9 (PRO-9), confirmed that operations at the university’s Kreutz Campus remained normal on Monday, but under stricter security measures.
